sentences.text:
The Court made the following:
 5  THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE TARLADA RAJASEKHAR RAO  WRIT PETITION Nos.13308 and 13373 OF 2023 COMMON ORDER:
Since the issue involved in both the writ petitions is one and the same, this Court deems it appropriate to dispose of these cases by way of this common order.

2. These writ petitions are filed seeking to set aside the Award No.26 of 2018, dated 24.10.2018,
insofar as the lands admeasuring Ac.1.11 cents in Sy.No.935-E and Ac.0.40 cents in Sy.No.138-C situated at Tadipatri Village, Tadipatri Mandal, Ananthapuram District.

3. Both the learned counsel for the petitioners as well as learned counsel appearing for 4th respondent submitted that the prayer in these writ petitions is similar to the prayer in W.A.No.744 of 2023 and batch and requested to pass similar order in these writ petitions.
4.

Acceding the request made by both the learned counsel for the petitioners as well as learned counsel for respondents, these Writ Petitions are disposed of in terms of the common order passed in W.A.No.744 of 2023 and batch dated 13.08.2024.
There shall be no order as to costs.

5. Office is directed to attach a copy of the common order passed in W.A.No.744 of 2023 and batch,
dated 13.08.2024, to these writ petitions.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
